title: Data Engineer
text: We are looking for a Data Engineer to build and run our data platform for customer analytics. Your day to day work is building reliable batch pipelines in Python and SQL, orchestrated with Apache Airflow, and loading data into our PostgreSQL warehouse. You will model data for analysts, write tests for transformations and keep our pipelines observable with clear alerts. Requirements: You have at least three years of experience in data engineering. You are strong in Python and SQL and have worked with an orchestrator such as Airflow. You understand dimensional modelling and data quality checks. You are comfortable working in Git and code review. Nice to have: experience with dbt, Docker or cloud storage. We offer a hybrid role in Aarhus, flexible hours, a learning budget and a team that values clear communication. The application deadline is in four weeks. Send your CV and a short note about a data pipeline you are proud of.

title: Registered Nurse
text: We are looking for a Registered Nurse for our residential care home for older adults. You will plan and deliver daily nursing care, give medication according to prescriptions, and support residents and their families with warmth and patience. You will work morning, evening and night shifts in a team of nurses and care assistants, and you will document each visit carefully. Requirements: You have a valid nursing licence and at least two years of experience on a ward or in elderly care. You are comfortable with wound care, hygiene routines and emergency response. You speak fluent English and you are able to lift and move residents safely. Nice to have: experience with dementia care and a driving licence. We offer a permanent position with a competitive salary, pension contribution, paid courses and a supportive team leader. Start date is flexible, and the position is based in Aarhus. Please attach your nursing licence and two references.

title: Analytics Engineer
text: Fjordbyg Data builds reporting products for logistics companies, and we are hiring an Analytics Engineer to own our transformation layer. You will write and maintain dbt models on top of our PostgreSQL warehouse, define metrics with the business teams and make sure dashboards are trustworthy. You will work with Airflow for scheduling and with Python for small ingestion scripts. Requirements: You have worked at least two years with SQL and dbt, and you can explain how you test and document models. You know Python well enough to write and review pull requests. You have a good understanding of data modelling and you communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues. Nice to have: experience with BI tools, Docker or a cloud data warehouse. We offer a hybrid role in Aarhus, a modern tool stack, a relaxed culture and flexible working hours. Apply with your CV and a short example of a dbt project you are proud of.
